simple: Finds phishing sites and look-alike domains using your brand, checks whether your IP addresses and domains have landed on blocklists, and watches for leaks in cloud storage, code repositories and malware-analysis services. Automatically files takedown requests for fake domains, social media pages, counterfeit apps and fraudulent sites and tracks them through to completion. For banks — detection of stolen payment cards. Has configurable playbooks with AI agents. Additionally monitors mobile apps and social networks (X, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, TikTok and others) — finds fake accounts posing as the company; and on the dark web — hacker discussions, leaks of employee and customer data, and passwords from infostealers and botnets. Audit log and SSO.
